technical_dispositions.review_items: PR1 H1/M1; PR3 N5; PR6b Low cleaning/QC
technical_dispositions.disposition: Exact-relation/parent policy retained; empty clean pools fail without replacing output; BACE follows its legacy canonical/charged schema and regenerates all 1513 rows exactly; shared relation guard and ultra-potent audit tested.

technical_dispositions.review_items: PR1 M2/L3; PR3 Low feature errors
technical_dispositions.disposition: Split-specific parameters and shuffled CV retained; invalid featurization fails closed.

technical_dispositions.review_items: PR1 M3; PR3 N7; PR5 P5; PR6b S5
technical_dispositions.disposition: 16 deterministic XGBoost refits reproduce historical R2 exactly and publish per-molecule predictions plus B=10000 paired intervals: RF 6 / XGB 1 / unresolved 9. hERG/scaffold XGB advantage +0.032305 [0.013851,0.050841]; these are nominal fixed-model test-sample intervals.

technical_dispositions.review_items: PR6b S7 and Low XGBoost same_pool
technical_dispositions.disposition: Check both train and test membership; record RF pool source. Unknown membership is unverified, never accepted from matching sizes.

technical_dispositions.review_items: PR1 L1/L2/L5; PR6b S7 and Low bootstrap
technical_dispositions.disposition: Bootstrap fractions remain descriptive, not p-values. Guard both n_boot and boot_seed, precompute all requested cells before publication, merge partial summaries, and resolve real figure paths. This is input-error protection, not crash-atomic multi-file publication.

technical_dispositions.review_items: PR1 M4; PR3 N12; PR6b S4
technical_dispositions.disposition: Separate per-seed-mean and prediction-ensemble estimands; summary tests recompute stored results.

technical_dispositions.review_items: PR3 N1/N2/N3/N8; PR5 P1/P6; PR6b S7 markers
technical_dispositions.disposition: Keep refreshed architecture results and conditional caveats; verify hollow fallback markers. Refresh 32 GINE uncertainty figure labels from saved statistics only; all 48 numeric CSV/JSON files unchanged.

technical_dispositions.review_items: PR3 N10; PR5 P7; PR6b Low interpretability and S7 output
technical_dispositions.disposition: Reconcile seven result JSON copies with the figure-source records; archive prior copies and record differing keys and hashes. Future runs write identical JSON to both destinations; default tag directory covered.

technical_dispositions.review_items: PR3 N11; PR5 P8
technical_dispositions.disposition: Notebook rebuilt from current pipeline, including BACE policy and empty-pool failure; byte-synchronization test passes.

technical_dispositions.review_items: PR5 P3/P4; PR6 R3/R4; PR6b Fetch; PR8 T7
technical_dispositions.disposition: Only named 18 random/scaffold models and 9 caches install. Key/hash receipts detect stale/corrupt complete trees; safe tar root/AppleDouble metadata supported. Interrupt rollback and surviving backups are truthful; legacy time models never install. Actual three-archive isolated installation passes with 11 raw pins, 18 models, 9 caches, zero time models. SIGKILL multi-file atomicity and publisher authenticity are not claimed.

technical_dispositions.review_items: PR6 R1; PR6b C1/S1; PR8 status of S1
technical_dispositions.disposition: Publish reproducible seed-deletion script: 14/48 historical random/scaffold cells conditional; 0/8 current time cells conditional across 24 drops. GNN-only deletion cannot establish RF seed robustness.

technical_dispositions.review_items: PR8 Low RF five-state SD; PR6b C1
technical_dispositions.disposition: 10 RF fits across a2a/hERG and seeds 42,1,2,3,4 with fixed data/parameters. Sample SD 0.026225/0.006136; seed42 reproduces original predictions within 2e-15. This does not recover the unpublished historical cohort.

technical_dispositions.review_items: PR6b S2; PR1 L1; PR2 correction
technical_dispositions.disposition: Disclose multiple comparisons and exploratory unadjusted per-cell intervals. Do not publish Bonferroni counts derived from 2*min(sign_fraction,1-sign_fraction): the PR2 identical-prediction counterexample refutes its calibration as a p-value.

technical_dispositions.review_items: PR3 N4/N9/N13; PR5 P2/P6; PR6 R2; PR6b C2/S3/S4
technical_dispositions.disposition: Remove causal shrinkage/representation claims, unsupported clear leads, unrun-split generalization and one-seed chemotype generalization; disclose allocation convention for spread/correlation. Match saved evidence rather than preserving superseded review claims.

technical_dispositions.review_items: PR6 R5; PR6b S6 and Low historical records
technical_dispositions.disposition: Refreshed EGFR GIN and multitask device/log gaps explicitly remain; old M3 multitask log is not evidence for refreshed run. Archived ep300 baseline pinned to actual historical revision and MPS record.

technical_dispositions.review_items: PR3 N14; PR6b Skill folder; PR8 Low skill records
technical_dispositions.disposition: Index all six original reports, preserve bytes, lint skill scripts in CI. --allow-skip only permits absent splits, not corrupt/misaligned splits. README verifier checks constant baseline and conditional markers; 447 cells, zero mismatches.

technical_dispositions.review_items: PR6b S7 fingerprint grid
technical_dispositions.disposition: Subgrid coverage includes bit sizes and seeds rather than assuming default grid completeness.

technical_dispositions.review_items: PR8 T1
technical_dispositions.disposition: All 24 scaffold-group sensitivity cells remain reported; 7/10 nominal molecule-level wins become unresolved with group resampling; limited scaffold counts disclosed.

technical_dispositions.review_items: PR8 T2/T3/T4/T5/T6
technical_dispositions.disposition: Current constant/decomposition, restored-checkpoint diagnostics, label-boundary/version guards, parent mismatch failures and published audit/repair tools retained. Independent full audit verifies 108 hashes and raw-label/prediction/bootstrap consistency; no checkpoint replay in this audit.

technical_dispositions.review_items: PR8 Low tooling/restore/signatures/mutation tests
technical_dispositions.disposition: Previously published Low acceptance remains historical evidence; final suite reruns real tiny-fit, interrupted publication/recovery and bundle/restore guards. Original 16 mutants absent; published ten explicit replacements are a different set.

technical_dispositions.review_items: PR8 Low out-of-AD/source concentrations/labels
technical_dispositions.disposition: Keep subset RMSE and label variance interpretation, a2a source concentration disclosure and corrected random-to-time labels.

documentation_dispositions.disposition: 当前方法文档说明仅保留精确关系测量，并记录数据刷新。
说明先标准化母体再去重，同时披露指纹相同分子的残余重叠。
文档记录按划分选择超参数；代码检查由主审核表记录。
XGBoost 三种子是确定性重复，不代表训练不确定性；另补测试样本 bootstrap。
明确逐种子 R² 均值差与平均预测的集成 R² 差是两个估计量。
y-randomization 控制差异来自训练池不包含验证集。
bootstrap 正号比例明确不是假设检验 p 值。
文档记录打乱的 RF 交叉验证协议。
说明归因分析的查询家族、Murcko 回退家族和机会基线限制。
Python 版本前提已说明；依赖与标准差实现见代码审核。
当前数值与组均值、单种子差异分别说明。
完整 GINE 面板与条件性、scaffold 分组敏感性限制已说明。
文档指向更新的森林图；图件验证见产物审核。
说明 AFP 改变来自独立 MPS 重跑，不能归因于未起约束作用的最低 epoch 参数。
旧机制归因已由当前常数基线和误差分解替代。
当前时间结果的 Git 恢复流程与旧发布包分开说明。
明确 EGFR 是重新拉取子集，另外七个拉取保持原记录数。
16 个 XGBoost 分数已精确复现并补配对区间。
适用域按各模型实际训练池计算；误差排序不等于概率校准。
当前与历史结果分开，修正旧调参实验日期与归档日期。
说明 chromone 当前零样本；复算三种子 thienopyrimidine MAE，方向不稳定。
多任务结果限定为逐种子均值比较，并修复访谈与归档引用。
披露 3.5–20.2% 指纹相同的测试分子；去盐只解决盐型重叠。
时间标签已改为 as-of 协议，代码边界见代码审核。
明确时间 RF 仅训练于 train_idx。
说明线性 IC50 与对数 pIC50 中位数不必互为变换。

BACE 专用历史兼容清洗已精确重建 1,513 行，并保留 ChEMBL 标准化路径。
仅观察到精确记录缺 pChEMBL 的单方向例外。
EGFR 与 egfr_full 重叠，不解释为独立八靶点证据。
当前 QC 已说明精确关系过滤。
明确最大单种子 +0.047 与组均值是不同口径。
区分半径和位宽主效应与特定单元的变化。
披露最优配置位于搜索边界及重复训练波动。
修正均值与集成非正格数混用。
分开查询核心和完整 Murcko 核心，说明机会水平。
重跑设备、非约束性最低 epoch 及种子条件性已说明。
原审查机制解释后来部分撤回；保留算术分解，不作因果归因。
当前时间统计可从 Git 恢复，经典模型复算需另取数据与缓存。
原版本不匹配指控被审查者撤回；现已复现全部 16 个 3.4.1 分数。
限定调参、多任务及键特征的描述性比较，撤回因果过度解释。
归因家族限制已说明；陈旧输出由主代理对账。
历史中间状态已有注释，补日志顺序和设备证据范围。
明确半径主效应与 r3/2048 的不同均值。
区分 4-anilinoquinoline 与 quinazoline。
保留 hERG 和 ABL1 学习曲线的正向例外。
只有 hivpr 正差需舍入后才不超过 0.010；确定性不妨碍样本 bootstrap。
条件性措辞已统一，撤回单侧删种子“加强 RF 稳健性”的说法。
说明误差分解中水平项与总量不依赖分配约定，其余项依赖。
原 EGFR 九次训练日志与设备仍缺失；新增显式来源限制，不伪造证据。

旧时间机制解释明确历史化并撤回因果过度推断。
区分 hERG 提升与种子波动，ABL1 重跑差异和 RF 对照。
旧 3.2.0 证据只涵盖 egfr_full；3.4.1 全 16 格已复现。
撤回缺日志支撑的 2026-10-13 clean_data 11 项计数，保留原日期记录。
查询和 Murcko 核心归因不跨家族直接合并。
加入减少集成规模的代数恒等式，说明只扰动 GNN 不能证明 RF 种子稳健。
补分解交叉项分配约定和历史 a2a 例子。
当前八个时间单元共 24 次删种子检查无翻转；旧 hivpr 条件性已被新结果取代。
明确区间与计数为未校正的探索性比较；不把 bootstrap 正号比例变成正式 Bonferroni 检验。
修正显著性过强、至少一个种子、fairness 幅度与噪声的措辞。
区分均值与集成口径；scaffold 非正格数分别为 7/8 和 5/8。
新增 16 格 XGBoost 配对 bootstrap，名义区间为 RF 6 / XGB 1 / 未决 9。
撤回用旧 multitask 日志证明刷新后设备的引用；新日志缺口仍披露。
修正日志设备断言、排列顺序和易失效行号引用。
多任务为均值比较而非所有集成均显著；补种子级 chemotype 限制。
六个基线指向精确历史提交；日志实际设备为 MPS，不是 CUDA。
保留历史运行日志里的本地路径作为记录，不声称跨机器可移植。
已报告全部 24 格 scaffold 分组 bootstrap 及少量分组的局限。
已加入训练均值常数基线及水平、排序解释。
使用最佳检查点诊断，13/24 启发式标记不被称为收敛证明。
来源版本和验收记录已定位；旧缺失资料不能靠叙述重造。
当前时间结果恢复路径不依赖旧 RF 时间模型发布包。
已完成 a2a 与 hERG 各五种子独立补充研究，固定当前标签、划分和已选超参数。总体 SD 分别为 0.023457 / 0.005488，样本 SD 为 0.026225 / 0.006136；不能因 hERG 舍入为 0.006 就认定复现了原审查队列。
用同一子集 RMSE/MAE 解释适用域差异，不单凭跨子集 R²。
说明单文档 371 个测试母体、三个原始 IC50 值但六个母体标签；不能证明单实验批次。
当前文档不再保留错误的 2.1 MiB 声称，恢复流程由清单验证。
原 16 个变异补丁缺失；公开新测试不冒充原实验。
